title: Evidence Request Register
description: Tracks outstanding requests for evidence items. All requests require human approval before transmission.

register_version.description: Semantic version of this register document.

generated.description: ISO 8601 date when this register snapshot was generated.

case_id.description: Parent case identifier — must match the register's case_id.

requested_item.description: Description of the specific document or evidence being requested.

requested_from.description: Organization or individual from whom the item is requested.

date_requested.description: ISO 8601 date the request was sent. Null if not yet sent.

request_method.description: Method used to transmit the request.

status.description: draft = prepared but not approved; pending_approval = awaiting human approval; sent = transmitted, awaiting response; received = response received; overdue = past deadline with no response; withdrawn = cancelled or superseded.

deadline.description: ISO 8601 date by which a response is legally required or expected. Null if not applicable.

response_date.description: ISO 8601 date the response was received. Null if not yet received.

received_evidence_ids.description: EV-{ID} items registered as a result of the response to this request.

related_claim_ids.description: CLAIM-{ID} entries that this request is intended to support.

outstanding_statuses.description: Requests with these statuses require attention: draft, pending_approval, sent (check deadline), overdue.
